name: Yumemidori
source:
...It all started with something so minor.

Highschooler Mizusawa Makoto ended up living with his brother after his parents moved abroad for work.
Having entered a new school, he slowly grew accustomed to his new life.

But, through his insignificant actions, his peaceful days began to go amiss...

[Translated from the [url=http://yandera.but.jp/yumemidori/story.html]official website[/url]]
